findings.title: Manifiesto de skills/plugins por sesion enorme (~200, del marketplace oficial auto-instalado); mayoria ajenos a DTD
findings.action: Via /plugin (interactivo): deshabilitar los plugins no usados del marketplace claude-plugins-official (legal, small-business, finance, data, design, operations, intercom, box, enterprise-search, product-tracking, cowork, brightdata). Es config GLOBAL + auto-gestionada -> no se edita a mano de forma durable (la auto-instalacion del marketplace oficial lo revierte). Unica via segura = el gestor /plugin.

findings.title: Higiene de config aplicada (2026-06-21): allow-lists podadas, additionalDirectory stale removido, git wildcards acotados, snapshot del reconciliador al dia
findings.action: Hecho: ~/.claude/settings.json allow 32->19 + additionalDirs 3->2 (motor-oferta); .claude/settings.local.json allow 24->18 (git add */push */commit -o); schema-reconciliation snapshot 0147->0151. Sin commitear (founder decide).

findings.title: Gate verify.mjs: paso test ~57s; vitest worker flaky en Windows ('failed to find the runner')
findings.action: Sin cambio (operacional); ante 'failed to find the runner' re-correr (crash transitorio, no regresion). Timeout 180s alcanza.
